timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Gryffid, second-in-command of Rhys's Hemlock pack, warns him against nonstandard tactics in a raid on boggarts; Rhys is stripped of rank and Gryffid becomes pack leader.
timeline.quote: Gryffid was elevated to leader of their pack.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath punishes Daen Rhys for the failed boggart raid, kills Yelm, demotes Rhys and gives the Hemlock pack to Gryffid.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the still-living skull of Yelm
